class.name: FloorResult
class.brief_description: The answer to whether there is ground under a character, and whether it may be stood on.
class.description: [member walkable_floor] is not implied by [member blocking_hit]: a steep slope is a hit that is not a floor, and telling those apart is what keeps a character from standing on a wall. The query runs in two phases. A shape sweep downward first, then a ray as the fallback for when the sweep caught something that is not a floor. The case the second phase exists for is a character standing where a wall meets the ground: the sweep reports the wall, and without the ray the character decides it has no floor and starts falling.

method.name: clear
method.description: Forgets this result, leaving it reporting no floor.

method.name: copy_from
method.description: Overwrites this result with another. Used where one floor query has to adopt the answer of a second without the two ever pointing at the same object.

method.name: get_collider
method.description: The object the floor belongs to, or [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_collider_velocity
method.description: The surface's own motion, as the sweep reported it. Zero for anything Godot does not track the movement of - an [AnimatableBody3D] reports a velocity, a [StaticBody3D] pushed around by a script does not.

method.name: get_distance_to_floor
method.description: The distance that actually applies, which is the ray's when the sweep did not produce this result.

method.name: is_walkable_floor
method.description: Whether there is a floor here and it may be stood on.

method.name: set_collider
method.description: Sets the object this floor belongs to.

method.name: set_collider_velocity
method.description: Sets the surface's own motion. Filled in by the floor query from what the sweep reported.
